scope.purpose: Prevent bounded repository or file-library searches from being promoted into exhaustive absence claims.

observed.claim: The canonical queue requires an exhaustive accessible branch inventory or equivalent repository history traversal before M-004, M-005, or M-006 may be classified as unlocated after exhaustive coverage.
Prior continuity slices rejected numeric-suffix collisions and retained the missing identifiers as unresolved rather than reconstructing history.
The available branch-search call returned no branch records, which is not evidence that the repository has no branches and cannot satisfy exhaustive coverage.
observed.source: authenticated GitHub connector branch-search result from this run

observed.claim: A recent-commit listing and a commit-message search for M-004 provide bounded positive or negative evidence only; neither enumerates every reachable commit on every accessible ref.
observed.source: authenticated GitHub connector commit searches from this run

lead_only.definition: Unverified prose, automation completion text, filenames, or semantic hints without immutable repository identity.

bounded_search.definition: A keyword, code, file-library, branch, or commit search with incomplete or provider-defined result coverage.

ref_inventory_complete.definition: All accessible branch and tag refs are enumerated with pagination completion evidence and immutable tip SHAs.

reachable_history_complete.definition: Every commit reachable from the complete accessible ref inventory is traversed exactly once or deduplicated by SHA, with traversal completion and raw-output integrity evidence.
may_support: repository-history no-match statement for inspected object classes
may_not_support: absence from inaccessible refs, deleted unreachable objects, private chat, or external storage

cross_source_exhaustive.definition: Reachable repository history is complete and each required non-repository source class has its own explicit complete-coverage evidence or is marked inaccessible.

promotion_rules.requires: An authenticated all-ref enumeration with explicit pagination completion and retained raw output.
A traversal of every commit reachable from every inventoried ref, with SHA deduplication and completion evidence.
Independent coverage accounting for decision logs, language lexicons, project documents, and authorized chat-history or file-library sources.

identity_resolution_rule.decision: A candidate resolves M-004, M-005, or M-006 only when all required dimensions agree. Numeric suffix or semantic similarity alone is insufficient.

claim_states.observed: Coverage requirements and bounded search results are directly supported by current repository and connector evidence.
claim_states.inferred: Existing no-match results cannot establish exhaustive absence because their reachable-ref and commit coverage is unproven.
claim_states.proposed: Adopt this coverage ladder as the mandatory gate for future provenance resolution and absence claims.
claim_states.superseded: Any statement that M-004, M-005, or M-006 are absent solely because a bounded search returned no valid match.
claim_states.unresolved: The immutable originating objects and source documents for M-004, M-005, and M-006 remain unlocated.

falsification_routes: Produce an immutable candidate object satisfying namespace, owner, semantic role, temporal precedence, and locator agreement.
Produce complete ref and reachable-history evidence showing the candidate exists under a previously uninspected ref.
Demonstrate that this coverage contract omits an accessible source class capable of assigning continuity identifiers.

privacy_boundary.publication_rule: Retain only source-class, coverage, digest, and classification metadata unless source content is independently approved for publication.

claim_ceiling: This contract defines what evidence would count as exhaustive. It does not itself provide exhaustive repository or cross-source coverage and does not classify the identifiers as nonexistent.
next_action: Run an authenticated all-ref inventory, retain paginated raw output and digest, traverse every reachable commit by SHA, and reconcile exact identifiers plus assigning-context terms before changing any unresolved node.
